customer_updates.name: Gaurav Tayade
customer_updates.text:
K. Rustom & Co. is not just an ice cream parlour — it’s a slice of Mumbai’s history, nostalgia, and sweetness served between two wafer biscuits. Located right opposite Marine Drive, this humble little shop has been delighting generations of Mumbaikars long before fancy dessert chains took over the city. Walking into K. Rustom’s feels like stepping back in time, where simplicity, tradition, and genuine flavor still matter.
The moment you enter, you’re greeted by a display filled with colorful ice cream sandwiches stacked neatly in their signature paper wraps. There’s no loud décor, neon lights, or Instagram aesthetic — and that’s exactly the charm of this place. It has retained its old-world authenticity over the decades, focusing purely on what truly matters: great taste and generous portions at affordable prices.
The menu may look simple, but every flavor carries its own personality. From classic favorites like strawberry, vanilla, and chocolate to more unique ones like walnut crunch, rum and raisin, raspberry ripple, and kesar pista — each scoop has a distinct richness. The ice cream is perfectly firm, creamy yet light, and the wafer adds that satisfying crunch which makes every bite nostalgic.
One of my personal favorites is their Walnut Crunch — it’s rich, nutty, and has that perfect balance of sweetness without being overpowering. The Rum and Raisin flavor, too, stands out with its mature taste and smooth texture. Even their Mango and Pineapple flavors are fresh and fruity, reminding you of homemade ice creams made with love.
What makes K. Rustom’s truly special, though, is the experience that surrounds it. You grab your ice cream sandwich, step outside, and just a few steps away is the iconic Marine Drive promenade. Sitting by the sea, enjoying the breeze, and relishing that cold, creamy delight as waves crash nearby — it’s a feeling that no modern dessert café can replicate. It’s Mumbai in its purest form — simple joys in a chaotic city.
Another reason people love K. Rustom’s is their consistency. They’ve been serving quality ice creams for decades, and despite the growing popularity, they haven’t changed their style or pricing drastically. The service is quick, the staff polite, and everything runs with quiet efficiency — just like it always has.
If you’re visiting Mumbai or even if you’ve lived here all your life, K. Rustom & Co. deserves a spot on your must-visit list. It’s a reminder that some things never need to change to stay perfect.
In a world of gourmet desserts and Instagram cafés, K. Rustom’s remains refreshingly old-fashioned — and that’s exactly what makes it legendary. A scoop of nostalgia, a dash of heritage, and a lot of happiness — that’s what every visit feels like. ❤️

featured_reviews.name: Cook with Swati Joshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had heard a lot about the famous ice cream sandwiches at Rustom & Co. from a friend, so I finally decided to visit. Honestly, I was shocked by the crowd! The rush was unbelievable—I never imagined this place was so popular. It felt just like standing in a long queue at a ticket counter.

After waiting for about 10–15 minutes, we finally placed our order. It genuinely felt like an achievement! The shop itself is very old and simple; looking at it, you wouldn’t guess how famous it is.

I tried the Mango Ice Cream Sandwich, and it was absolutely delicious. The ice cream tasted fresh, rich, and homemade. I was actually wondering how they manage to keep the ice cream so perfectly firm. The combination of creamy ice cream placed between two wafers was simple yet amazing.

If you’re visiting Churchgate, this place is definitely worth trying at least once. Great taste, nostalgic charm, and an experience you’ll remember.

Highly recommended! 🍦✨

featured_reviews.review_text: An iconic ice cream shop in Mumbai. They sell ice cream sandwich that uses wafers instead of bread. featured_reviews.name: Sangeerthana R
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited K. Rustom & Co Ice Cream Parlour near Churchgate, and it was a delightful experience that felt both nostalgic and satisfying. The place has an old-world charm that immediately stands out. From the simple setup to the long-standing reputation, everything about it feels rooted in tradition rather than trends.
The ice cream sandwiches are clearly the highlight here, and they did not disappoint. I tried a classic combination, and the thick, creamy ice cream paired with soft wafers tasted incredibly rich and fresh. The flavors are straightforward but very well done, without being overly sweet. You can tell that the focus is on quality rather than variety or presentation.
What I really liked was the no-frills approach of the place. There is no seating or fancy décor, yet people patiently line up just for the taste. Watching customers from different age groups enjoying their ice creams made the visit feel warm and familiar. It is one of those places where the experience is as much about the memory as it is about the food.
Overall, K. Rustom & Co is a must-visit if you are in Mumbai. It offers simple, honest ice cream and leaves you with a smile and a sense of nostalgia.

featured_reviews.name: Yasmin Begum

would love to visit this place again.

featured_reviews.name: Govind Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
K. Rustom & Co. is not just an ice cream parlour—it’s a timeless Mumbai experience that perfectly blends nostalgia, simplicity, and great taste. Located near Churchgate Station, opposite the Ambassador Hotel, this iconic spot has been serving its legendary ice cream sandwiches since 1953, and it truly lives up to its reputation.
The highlight here is undoubtedly their signature ice cream sandwiches—thick, creamy slabs of ice cream pressed between crisp wafer biscuits. The texture is rich and smooth, never icy, and the flavours are honest, balanced, and not overly sweet. We tried a variety of flavours including Walnut Crunch, Coffee, Kesar Pista, Pista, Vanilla, Choco Crunch, Candied Cream, and Chocolate Almond. Chocolate Almond and Walnut Crunch stood out as absolute favourites, while Coconut Pista felt slightly below average. Each flavour tasted true to its name, showcasing quality over gimmicks.
What makes K. Rustom & Co. special is its no-frills, old-world charm. There’s no fancy décor or seating—just a simple setup where people from all age groups patiently queue up for a taste of nostalgia. The service is quick and efficient, even during peak hours, though it can feel a bit rushed due to the crowd. The place is often busy, especially in the evenings and on weekends, which only proves its enduring popularity.
Prices are very reasonable considering the quality and legacy. Do note that the outlet accepts cash only, so it’s best to come prepared. There’s no parking, no photography allowed inside, and occasionally some flavours may be unavailable—but these minor inconveniences are easy to overlook once you take that first bite.
Overall, K. Rustom & Co. offers simple, authentic ice cream with a strong emotional connect. It’s perfect for a quick dessert after a walk at Marine Drive or for introducing visitors to a true taste of Mumbai’s culinary heritage. Not fancy, not modern—just classic, comforting, and memorable. A must-visit for every dessert lover in Mumbai. 🍨✨

featured_reviews.name: Merlin
featured_reviews.review_text: K. Rustom & Co. is one of Mumbai's most iconic old-school ice cream parlours, located near Churchgate. Established in 1953, it is best known for its signature ice cream sandwiches tucked between thin wafer biscuits. They offer classic flavors like vanilla and chocolate along with favorites such as mango, raspberry, and butterscotch each bite tasting nostalgic and timeless. The place carries a charming vintage vibe and is perfect for a quick sweet stop after a walk at Marine Drive. Prices are reasonable, but there's no seating available, and you can usually expect a bit of waiting time due to its popularity. They do not accept card or online payments, it’s cash only, so make sure to carry cash before visiting.

featured_reviews.name: Tanmay Ayare
featured_reviews.review_text:
K. Rustom & Co. – A Mumbai Classic Ice Cream That Never Disappoints

Location - Near Churchgate Station, opposite Ambassador Hotel, Mumbai

Stepping into K. Rustom & Co. is like taking a trip back in time and every bite of their iconic ice cream sandwiches takes you even further. A true Mumbai institution, this old-school parlour continues to win hearts with its unique charm and legendary flavours.

What We Tried

We ate a delicious range of flavours:

- Walnut Crunch – nutty, creamy, and perfectly balanced

- Coffee – subtle, strong, and not overly sweet

- Candied Cream – fun, nostalgic. Kids would love it

- Pista – smooth and mildly flavoured

- Choco Crunch – rich chocolate with bits of crunch that added great texture

- Paan – surprisingly refreshing with just the right hit of paan essence

All of them were served between their signature thin wafer biscuits, making it easy to eat (and very photogenic!). The texture is dense yet smooth, and each flavour felt true to its name.

Price & Experience

Prices are very affordable, especially considering how unique and satisfying the product is. Do note: it’s cash-only and no seating, but that’s part of the charm.

Service is quick and straightforward. You queue up, pick your flavour, pay, and step outside most likely with a smile.

Verdict

K. Rustom & Co. is not just an ice cream parlour, it's a Mumbai experience.
If you're near Marine Drive or Churchgate, make this a stop. Perfect for a post-walk treat or to introduce visitors to a taste of Mumbai's legacy.

A classic Mumbai stop! Just near Churchgate, this place is legendary for a reason. Stopped in for a few scoops with friends and it was the perfect refreshing end to the day.
We got a mix of flavors. The one that tastes like Tender Coconut is a must-try – so creamy with real coconut bits. The yellow scoop (likely mango or pineapple) was also delicious, and the dark berry/black currant was super flavorful.
What’s great is that their ice cream doesn’t taste artificial at all – you can tell they use actual fruit, milk, and sugar without preservatives. It has a super smooth and consistent texture every single time. It’s also very pocket-friendly for the quality.
The shop can get quite busy, but the service is quick. Highly recommend popping by if you're in South Mumbai, grabbing a cup or a cone, and taking a walk down to Marine Drive. It's a true Mumbai staple that never disappoints!

featured_reviews.review_text:
Natural Ice Cream at Marine Drive, Churchgate is always a happy place for me 😍🍦 The location itself makes everything better — cool breeze, sea view, and tasty ice cream in hand 🌊✨ We went in the evening and the place was lively but still well managed.
We tried almond and coconut flavours and honestly both were amazing 😋🥥 The coconut flavour tasted very fresh and natural, like real coconut, not artificial at all. Almond was creamy, rich, and had a nice nutty taste that stayed till the end 🤌🍨 Every spoon felt smooth and satisfying.
What I really love about Natural Ice Cream is the simplicity. No heavy sweetness, no fake flavours, just clean and real taste ❤️ The staff was polite and quick, and we didn’t have to wait long even though many people were there 👍
Sitting near Marine Drive enjoying these flavours made the evening extra special 🌆✨ Perfect place to chill after a walk or just relax with friends or family. Totally worth visiting and I’ll definitely come back again to try more flavours

featured_reviews.name: Roopin Rameshan
featured_reviews.review_text: On our latest visit, we finally tasted the seasonal Mango Malai, and it lives up to the hype as the king of flavors. Highly recommend grabbing one before the season wraps up!

featured_reviews.name: Kunal Singh
featured_reviews.review_text: Naturals Ice Cream at Marine Drive is the perfect late-night stop, offering a lively and quintessential Mumbai experience that is well worth the hustle. The outlet was packed with a massive crowd, buzzing with energy, but the chaotic atmosphere only added to the charm of enjoying a treat by the bay. The ice creams were fresh and flavorful as always: the Anjeer and Sitaphal were incredibly creamy with authentic fruit textures, while the Mango offered a burst of pure, seasonal sweetness. The Coffee Walnut provided a delightful crunch and rich aroma that balanced the fruitier options perfectly. Despite the long lines and the rush, grabbing a scoop here and enjoying the cool night breeze remains an unbeatable way to end the evening.

featured_reviews.name: Harry Smith
featured_reviews.review_text: Fantastic Ice creams to rival any in Italy, I came back 4 days in a row... Ops got through all the flavours... featured_reviews.name: Satsangharsha
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you're around Marine Drive and craving something sweet, Naturals Ice Cream near Marine Drive is a must-visit spot! Tucked in a great location, just a short walk from the sea face, this outlet offers the perfect combination of delicious treats and a relaxing atmosphere. Whether you’re out with friends, family, college buddies, or even on a casual date, this place works for everyone — kids will love it too!
They have an amazing variety of flavors, and I especially love the chocolate ones. Rich, creamy, and satisfying — you can really taste the quality. They also offer some unique seasonal fruit flavors that you don’t find at many other places. Everything tastes fresh and authentic.
The vibe of the store is serene, chic, and very clean. It's not overcrowded, which makes it a great place to unwind. The staff here are polite, well-trained, and efficient. Even when it’s busy, the service is pretty quick, which is always appreciated.
Overall, it’s a great spot to take a break from the hustle of the city, enjoy some excellent ice cream, and just soak in the vibe of South Mumbai. Highly recommended!

Tried this hand-churned ice cream and it honestly stands out from the usual. The texture is rich and creamy without being too heavy, and you can really taste the freshness in every bite.

The guava flavor was a surprise hit—perfectly balanced between sweet and tangy, just like real fruit. The mixed fruit was equally refreshing, with a nice blend that didn’t feel artificial at all.

Simple, authentic, and done right. Definitely coming back for more.

featured_reviews.name: Kanchan Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text: Quaint little place, with all the construction going on in the area, a little tough to find now but it is an institution, so anyone will happily lead you to the place. Tiny place but what it has to offer makes you forget everything else. Personally for me Chickoo and sitaphal were mid blowing! The other flavors were also great! So much so that we actually had a kilo of it parceled for home. It is a must try and it will beat any mass produced ice cream without a doubt!

featured_reviews.name: wilford machado
featured_reviews.review_text: One of the best ice creams in the city. If i had to compare it with a more popular brand, i would say this is like a premium version of Naturals ice cream with denser and richer flavours. After trying almost all their flavours, I feel muskmelon, apricot and mango are my top favourites. Guava is good too but the spice they use has too much salt in it which can ruin the experience. While the entire experience is quite nice, wish they let customers taste before buying like most other premium ice cream vendors. Expensive for a shop with no seating but still worth the visit even if you are not in the area.

featured_reviews.name: Kuldip Deshmukh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Taj Ice Cream, Bohri Mohalla ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
A Mumbai institution since 1887, Taj Ice Cream is the real deal. Six generations of the Jalalji family have kept the tradition alive — no additives, no shortcuts, just handmade ice cream churned the old-fashioned way with real fruit and secret family recipes.
The Cassata is legendary, the fruit flavours taste genuinely fresh, and the humble old-school setting in the heart of Bohri Mohalla adds to the charm. Tourists and locals alike swear by it, and one scoop tells you why.
Don’t visit Mumbai without stopping here.

featured_reviews.name: Murtaza Badri
featured_reviews.review_text:
Experience the most unique hand churned ice cream taste in Mumbai. If your travelling to Mumbai, don't miss out on this amazing ice cream heritage from 1930s.
Every season has their own flavors. We tried the standard mango, strawberry and in season Guava with tajin.
Enjoyed every flavor every spoon.

featured_reviews.name: Sahil Gawand
featured_reviews.review_text: Had an amazing experience at Taj Icecreams in Bohri Mohalla, Mohammed Ali Road. The ice cream is incredibly rich, creamy, and full of authentic flavor — especially the seasonal fruit options. Simple, old-school vibe with quick and friendly service. A must-visit if you’re in the area. Highly recommended! 🍨

featured_reviews.name: muku
featured_reviews.review_text: I'd heard about Taj Ice Cream online as an old (nearly 200 years old) establishment that was a favourite among golden era bollywood celebrities and used quality ingredients to make hand churned ice cream. We tried their malai, strawberry and guava flavours. All were understated and not too sweet with a chewy, dense texture, the best commercially available ice cream I've ever had. It seems to not be packed with much air and is so dense that you could fill yourself up on a scoop or two (costing 100 rs epr scoop). Loved the little photo of Waheeda Rehman enjoying her ice cream on the wall near the entrance.

featured_reviews.name: Sakib Mulla
featured_reviews.review_text:
🥛 Parsi Dairy Farm (Est. 1916): A Testament to Purity
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ An Uncompromising Pillar of Mumbai's Culinary Tradition
Parsi Dairy Farm is not merely a sweet shop; it is a gastronomic institution and a tangible link to Mumbai’s rich Parsi and Gujarati dairy heritage. Established in 1916, this centenary establishment embodies an unwavering commitment to purity and age-old methods, standing proudly against modern industrial practices.
Their specialization is milk elevated to an art form. The legendary Malai Kulfi is essential—rich, dense, and incomparable in texture and flavor. During season, the traditional, hand-churned Sancha Ice Cream is a must-try, offering a taste of dairy that is increasingly rare. Traditionalists will also value their high-grade Ghee and delicate Saffron Petha.
You must be prepared for premium pricing, but you are investing in unmatched quality and a dedication to ingredients that few other places can claim. The no-frills, transaction-focused setting perfectly underscores their mission: the product speaks for itself.
For the definitive, authentic taste of classic Mumbai confectionery and dairy excellence, Parsi Dairy Farm is an essential stop. A perfect 5/5 for tradition, purity, and taste.

featured_reviews.name: Ashish Choadhry
featured_reviews.review_text:
An old establishment from 1916 and still continuing its legacy. Visited the Princess Street outlet with is probably the first outlet of their.
Their have own dairy products like Ghee, Kulfi, Milk, Sweets and chocolates. We tried the traditional malai kulfi and trust me it's very nice. They offer seven flavours in kulfi apart from several sweets and other dairy products.
They also have the traditional milk chocolate which is a favourite amongst kids. They also have ghee, butter etc.
The outlet stands out due to the lively colours used in the branding. They have kept old memorabilia which is also used for decorative displays and other purposes. Loved the idea of old milk cans used as seating stools. Displays old coupons which were exchanged daily when milk was supplied to the customer. The measures used for milk, old milk cans, coupon books etc are all treasures and the present generation must definitely have a look at them. More than an outlet, it also doubles up as a museum too.

The quality of the products is extremely good and the place is very clean and hygienic. This place is definitely a must visit whenever you are in Mumbai.

Staff is also very friendly and good. All the best.

featured_reviews.name: Harsha S
featured_reviews.review_text: I tried their mango pastry and chocolate Bamboloni. Both was soo good. U get mango in every bite and Bamboloni was filled with good amount of chocolate. Worth the try

featured_reviews.name: Rowland Kevin
featured_reviews.review_text:
Excellent cakes, the chocolate and pineapple pastries are delicious, soft and creamy. I wouldn't recommend the red velvet though, because they used whipped cream instead of cream cheese frosting and that sucks, which is the only reason for not giving this a 5! During seasons you even get mango, gulab jamun and rasmalai cakes. Do check them out.

Not very budget friendly, but good quality whatsoever.

featured_reviews.name: Rujuta Acharekar
featured_reviews.review_text: For a birthday celebration this is a perfect place to get the cake for your loved ones. We got the dark forest cake. And believe me I have never tasted a dark forest as delicious as this. It had the perfect amount of whip cream also a layer of  dark chocolate between the soft spongy layers of cake. They also have amazing presentation. These cakes are worth the price. Dark temptations goes with its names that there cakes really looks tempting. We all gulp they cake so fast because it tasted yummy and we couldn't stop yourself from taking a bite everytime.

featured_reviews.name: Vinay
featured_reviews.review_text:

featured_reviews.name: Care Share
featured_reviews.review_text:
I ordered a butterscotch half kg cake yesterday.
Utterly disappointed.
Was just crème a very thin layer of cake.
The other tea cake I picked from the shelf was exceptionally good.
Dark Temptation you didn’t make my day! 😒

featured_reviews.name: VruShali Kamble
featured_reviews.review_text: I ordered mango cakes in may, it’s fixed every year. You have to consume this within 6 hours. The cake loaded with real Alphonso slices with cream. Price for this cake is 850. Highly recommended this in summer season otherwise we can choose rasmalai cake also that also best choice

featured_reviews.name: Affan Chishti
featured_reviews.review_text:
It was a pleasure to visit this cake shop,
I wished to have a rasmalai cake, which wasn't available so after having a word with the manager he agreed to make it for me on urgent basis,
It was really helpful for me that dark temptations made a cake on such a short notice and took my celebration a step ahead ⚡❣️

Highly recommended 🔥❤️

featured_reviews.name: Raheen Jummani
featured_reviews.review_text: These guys are the best,  intact the Bestest.. what amazing cakes whether chocolate or fruit all the cakes are amazing.. their fruit cakes have actual fresh fruits and not canned fruits... their staff is super helpful and polite.. have been your dedicated customer since years.. Keep spreading the Sweetness and Happiness.. Sharing some pics of recently ordered cakes from Dark Temptations
